config.rationale: Fast, low-risk baseline to establish a performance floor and validate hyperparameter choices. hidden=32 with 3 layers keeps the model small and fast to train, enabling quick iteration. Slightly higher lr (2e-3) compensates for the smaller capacity. Larger batch (256) reduces gradient noise for the simpler architecture. Dropout 0.3 provides stronger regularisation appropriate for the smaller model. Three augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90) maximise data diversity for the limited capacity. This candidate serves as a reference point: if residual_cnn or compact_transformer do not substantially outperform it, the added complexity is not justified.
